run.name: AMC Entertainment Holdings Inc
run.title: CP-OS host session (AMC)
run.summary: AMC is a recovering but thinly cushioned credit: trailing earnings cut leverage to 4.50x and extended maturities, yet fixed charges, film-slate dependence and cash-only liquidity leave little room for a weak year. Launched through CP-OS as of 2026-11-05 on the retained context; the EDGAR registrant name in that context is AMC ENTERTAINMENT HOLDINGS, INC..

revenue.basis: Total revenues, as the CP-1 table prints it.

leverage.basis: Total debt / EBITDA. Principal 3,782.6 (S4 page:12) over LTM Adjusted EBITDA 840.4 (C1); net of cash 751.9 (S4 page:3). Calculated, C3. LTM mixes the earlier definition (FY2025) with the 2026 definition (S4 page:27); sensitivity in C1 is 0.9. Finance leases 50.7 and operating leases excluded

coverage.basis: EBITDA / cash interest. LTM Adjusted EBITDA 840.4 over LTM cash interest paid 392.3 (C2). Calculated, C4. Earlier and 2026 Adjusted EBITDA definitions mixed

cash.basis: Cash. Unrestricted cash (S4 page:3); restricted cash of 39.6 excluded. Absence of a described facility is not a printed zero

cashflow.basis: Net cash from operating activities, as the CP-1 table prints it.

gaps: Host session: an agent answered every module from the pinned filings and CP-5 is its own review. No independent review has been made. Treat the analysis as candidate.
CP-2 main limitation: Trailing earnings mix two definitions, covenant levels and executed documents are not supplied, and ownership is not disclosed.
CP-1 main limitation: Trailing earnings mix two Adjusted EBITDA definitions, and no undrawn facility is described.
